about: IT Systems Engineer with hands-on experience across Linux administration, containerization, and CI/CD automation, built through day-to-day operational support and through infrastructure projects I design and run myself end to end.
Day to day, I configure and troubleshoot VPS infrastructure, manage DNS and Cloudflare routing, and handle mail system migrations, with a focus on stability and security-oriented configuration.
On the side, I build and deploy my own projects: Dockerized applications, GitHub Actions pipelines with automated VPS deployment, nginx/TLS setup, and structured post-deploy security audits.
I also work with structured data systems - redesigning reporting logic around bookkeeping data models and rebuilding calculated fields from legacy MDB/DLL sources for dashboard reporting.
